          -- Factors of 45: 1×45, 3×15, 5×9
          -- So q+7-m and q+7+m are factors

          have h₇ : q + 7 - m > 0 := by

          have h₈ : q + 7 + m > 0 := by
            nlinarith

theorem rmo_2001_2 (p q : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) :

              nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p - q)]

              by_contra h_le
              have h_eq_m : m = p + q := by omega
              rw [h_eq_m] at hm
              ring_nf at hm
              have h_zero : 5 * p * q = 0 := by omega
              have h_pos : 0 < p * q := mul_pos (Nat.Prime.pos hp) (Nat.Prime.pos hq)

            have h_k_pos : 0 < k := by
              rw [hk]
              omega

              rw [hk]
              ring

              calc
                k * (2 * (p + q) + k) = (m - (p + q)) * (m + (p + q)) := by
                  rw [hk]
                  ring
                _ = m^2 - (p + q)^2 := by ring
                _ = (p^2 + 7*p*q + q^2) - (p^2 + 2*p*q + q^2) := by rw [hm]; ring
